name: the licence policed: objections to the play, its limits and its end
what_it_changes: Within F01, members object to the play and police the licence: they set limits on taste and repetition, demand labels, deletion, restoration or better jokes, and dispute when the licence ends.
why: Cut rule R3 (tree-D4.md): a level-3 child of F01's key, held by 5 or more of F01's members, whose lines (read whole in _analysis/d4a01_lines_K01_addstep.txt) state a narrower change than F01's. The lines under T3-032 (objecting to April Fools posts) state this: 'Participants police the scope of licensed joking' (bostonceltics); 'Members dispute when the temporary licence ends' (dankmemes); 'Members demand restoration and dispute the prank's duration' (chelseafc); 'Moderators enforce duplication and relevance limits during the joke licence' (elitedangerous). These are the labelers' how sentences.
